entries.zh:
alias: 每天清掉吵鬧功率感測器的舊資料
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "04:15:00"
actions:
  - action: recorder.purge_entities
    data:
      keep_days: 5
      entity_id: sensor.power_sensor_0
mode: single
entries.en:
alias: Clear old data from noisy power sensors every day
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "04:15:00"
actions:
  - action: recorder.purge_entities
    data:
      keep_days: 5
      entity_id: sensor.power_sensor_0
mode: single

entries.zh:
alias: 資料庫太肥就通知我
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.database_size
    above: 2000
    for: "01:00:00"
conditions: []
actions:
  - action: notify.persistent_notification
    data:
      title: 資料庫警告
      message: 資料庫已經超過 2000 MiB（大約 2 GB），該去看看是誰在灌水了。
mode: single
entries.en:
alias: Notify me if the database is too big
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.database_size
    above: 2000
    for: "01:00:00"
conditions: []
actions:
  - action: notify.persistent_notification
    data:
      title: Database warning
      message: The database has exceeded 2000 MiB (approximately 2 GB), it's time to find out who is spamming it.
mode: single
